request.style: English, children's marching song, cheerful male lead vocal with kids choir, marching snare drum, trumpet, tuba, glockenspiel, hand claps and stomps, playful and bold, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jericho was shut up tight
No one out and no one in
Walls so high and gates so strong
How could Israel ever win
But the LORD said to Joshua
See, I give this town to you
March around it, trust in me
That is all you have to do

[Chorus]
March, march, round and round
Ram's horn trumpets make a sound
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven
Shout to the LORD, the God of heaven

[Verse]
Day one, day two, round we go
Feet go stamping, nice and slow
Not a word and not a cheer
Only trumpets loud and clear
Day three, day four, five and six
Once around and back to camp
Quiet mouths and listening ears
Stamp, stamp, stamp, stamp

[Chorus]
March, march, round and round
Ram's horn trumpets make a sound
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven
Shout to the LORD, the God of heaven

[Verse]
On day seven, up at dawn
Round and round and round and on
Seven times they marched around
Then the trumpets, what a sound
Shout! For the LORD has given you the city
Everybody, take a breath
Shout! For the LORD has given you the city
And the wall fell down flat

[Bridge]
Rahab's house was safe inside
With the red cord at the wall
God keeps every promise made
God is stronger than it all

[Chorus]
March, march, round and round
Ram's horn trumpets make a sound
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven
Shout to the LORD, the God of heaven
